verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 that it says provides programmatic access to all compute resources, covering Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes and registries. A GraphQL API, an S3-compatible API for network volumes, and a CLI that also exposes account information fill out much of the console's surface. Missing for 10: evidence of API parity for billing, auto-pay and team/account settings; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent confirmation that nothing is console-only.
